auth.demo_human_decision_condition: Explicit demo mode, synthetic tenant, server-bound seeded founder/lawyer session and actual interactive decision; never accepted by non-demo handler.
auth.expected_epoch_rule: Human commands may provide expected_reset_epoch only as a precondition; authoritative reset_epoch comes from surviving tenant guard and trusted server context.

declared_ca_resident_ccpa_bundle.behavior: Retrieve pinned operative CCPA applicability and privacy-disclosure provisions plus evidence-map requirements; never infer coverage from residence alone.

declared_ca_resident_company_facts.behavior: Retrieve same-tenant authoritative context revision, nulls and conflicts, coverage facts, data practices and operational followups; never write facts.

adaptive_policy.whole_candidate_diff: All bytes outside the two allowed boolean values remain unchanged. No removal/addition/ancestor/escaped path or arbitrary prompt string.

source_fetch.dns_rule: All A/AAAA answers and connected peer must be globally routable; reject loopback/private/link-local/multicast/reserved/unspecified/IPv4-mapped bypass; connect only to a validated resolution while retaining hostname TLS verification. No live SSRF probe performed.
source_fetch.credentials: No cookies, auth headers, cloud credentials or client URL userinfo on public fetches; no PII in query
source_fetch.endpoint_source: curated registry IDs; models cannot fetch arbitrary URLs

trace_policy.external_export: Construct T13 DTO only; HMAC pseudonyms replace tenant/workflow/run/correlation IDs; no automatic model/tool wrappers; metadata/tags/errors/attachments also filtered.

source_recheck_attestation.schema_owner: T05 exact schema; T04 physical collection

reset_fence.authority: persistent tenant guard reset_epoch; never model supplied
reset_fence.guard_write_required: conditional CAS/touch of the same persistent tenant guard; snapshot-only read is insufficient for reset serialization
reset_preconditions: retain unresolved model charges and live-send intents/receipts outside discarded fixture epoch, or block reset until reconciled
advance surviving tenant guard before deletion/reseed
reset_fence.late_result: old epoch diagnostic only; never attach to new same UUID or replay old receipt

review_reset_fence.required: expected_reset_epoch equals trusted context reset_epoch equals current surviving tenant guard reset_epoch; nonnegative input does not grant authority
review_reset_fence.conditional_write: Every decision/effect transaction conditionally writes the same surviving tenant guard using tenant_id and reset_epoch, plus material epochs and review_fence as applicable. Snapshot read alone is insufficient.
review_reset_fence.external_effects: Recheck trusted tenant/epoch at model/tool/email dispatch and before effect commit; reset quiesces old dispatch and retains unknown charges/send intents. An already-dispatched external request cannot be retracted by advancing epoch.
